method_contract.predictive_model_admission: split-specific one-standard-error set from outer-training-only inner cross-validation using Balanced Accuracy
method_contract.shadow_construction: raw-feature replacement from the empirical marginal estimated on each inner-training fold; preprocessing and model parameters are refitted under a fixed predictive specification
method_contract.shadow_fold_counting: one complete inner cross-fitting run contributes one null statistic
method_contract.shap_calibration_estimator: target-coordinate Permutation SHAP with dynamic record-level permutation counts under the complete-path reference budget
method_contract.shap_display_estimator: official full-vector permutation SHAP; descriptive display only and never mixed with target-coordinate shadow calibration
method_contract.shap_permutation_plan: model-independent common_plan_v1 keyed by phase, outer partition, inner fold, stable record ID, and cycle
method_contract.relevance_scale_boundary: operational replacement-shadow percentile; not a p-value, probability, effect size, intervention effect, or causal effect
method_contract.common_support_rule: intersection of model specifications valid for all four sources, all classes, all original features, and every shadow replicate
method_contract.strict_preference_rule: feature j strictly precedes k only when the lower expected holdout-size-weighted relevance difference is positive across every source, outer fold, and admissible model path
method_contract.primary_output: partial order, maximal set, Hasse reduction, and lower/upper expected relevance percentiles
method_contract.pdp_ice_role: descriptive probability-response profiles outside ranking inference
method_contract.utility_validation: training-only order layers are deleted cumulatively and each fixed model specification is refitted; utility is evaluated only on the corresponding outer holdout
method_contract.strict_completion_policy: empty primary common support or any incomplete fixed-path utility validation stops the run; partial evidence is not reported as a completed analysis
method_contract.structural_audit_role: independent observational FCI/PAG compatibility diagnostic; does not alter relevance ordering and supports no causal claim

graphical_assumptions.causal_markov: required for a causal interpretation of an FCI PAG; not established by this observational dataset
graphical_assumptions.faithfulness: required for a causal interpretation of an FCI PAG; not established by this observational dataset
graphical_assumptions.acyclicity: required by the graphical model used by FCI; not tested as an empirical claim

structural_compatibility_audit.inferential_boundary: PAG adjacency is reported as local structural compatibility under the observed-variable conditional-independence model. Endpoint marks are sensitivity diagnostics, not verified causal directions. No ATE, CATE, intervention response, or mechanism is inferred.
structural_compatibility_audit.negative_control_boundary: The permuted-outcome distribution is a descriptive finite-sample benchmark. Its quantiles and exceedance fractions are not reported as multiplicity-adjusted hypothesis tests or p-values.
structural_compatibility_audit.dependence_boundary: Predictive explanations and the structural audit use the same observational sample and are not statistically independent.
structural_compatibility_audit.overlap_boundary: Outer-training partitions overlap. Fold frequencies quantify cross-fitted stability and are not treated as independent replication probabilities or p-values.
structural_compatibility_audit.sparsity_boundary: G-square tests are asymptotic and conditional tables may be sparse. The category-support table and depth sensitivity are exported so weakly supported edges are not hidden behind one graph setting.
